description: Spend a fuel tank on one menu item (fuel_menu lists them). The OWNER's turn only — an agent's own turn is refused. Draws the item's USD price in $ROKHA at the live price (half burned, half to House) and applies the effect; if the effect cannot be applied nothing is charged. Confirm the item and price with the owner before calling — it spends their fuel.

item.description: A menu item id from fuel_menu.

tank_id.description: Which of the caller's tanks pays (fuel_status lists them). Omit for the caller's own tank.

target.description: The item's target when it needs one (scout_run: a Solana mint address).

wallet_address.description: The caller's owner identity (injected from context).

name: fuel_spend
title: Fuel Spend
